description: Registry of known inverter-vendor implementations for the solar-power-station template. The framework's `--vendor=<name>` flag on `claw co create` reads this file to resolve where the named vendor's MCP server source comes from.

_status_values.reference: The template maintainer endorses this implementation as the canonical reference
_status_values.community: Third-party implementation; conforms to the contract but maintained independently
_status_values.stub: Mock data only — useful for tests; not for production

_source_schemes.bundled: Implementation ships inside the template at the given bundled_path. After `claw co create`, the source is already in <service>/<bundled_path>/.
_source_schemes.github: Implementation lives in an external GitHub repo. Format: github:<owner>/<repo>[/<subpath>]. The framework will git-clone the repo and copy <subpath> (or the repo root if no subpath) into <service>/workspace/skills/vendor-<name>/.

sungrow.description: SunGrow iSolarCloud — string and central inverters, regional endpoints (cn/us/eu). Production implementation (~170KB, 22 tools: 5 contract + 17 vendor-specific) maintained at github.com/JK8769/claw-solar-vendors.
sungrow.notes: `claw skill add vendor-sungrow` clones the repo, copies vendor-sungrow/ into workspace/skills/vendor-sungrow/, and auto-compiles to bin/vendor-sungrow. For local dev (without internet) the bundled stub at workspace/skills/vendor-sungrow/ from `claw co create` still works as a fallback; replace it manually if needed.

_examples_external._comment: Reference examples of github-sourced entries — copy into `implementations` and populate with real URLs once the vendor monorepo exists.

huawei.description: Huawei FusionSolar — string inverters for residential + C&I, smart string monitoring.

goodwe.description: GoodWe SEMS Portal — string and hybrid inverters.
